verdicts.reason: The Missing Second Manuscript: names MEGA¹ as 'the first critical edition of Marx and Engels's complete works' and says what it and MEGA² did, correctives to Kautsky's liberties and to Soviet collections (D); states the pattern of custodial modification of Marx's manuscripts (O-class, the second class); holds its suppression hypothesis at its stated limit
Scholarly Legwork for Three Pillars: gives the 1844 Manuscripts' custody chain through Riazanov's MEGA¹ and their critical editions MEGA¹ I.3 and MEGA² I.2 (documented facts of the entity's volumes)

Sémantique Potentielle Release 3 (Johannes Sigil): the mint X-M13, editorial calcification, defined and applied to MEGA¹ I.3 (1932), an archive category applied to the entity's volume (O-direct, with the name: D). #1218, the same release recovered, is an instance of this lineage (S4) and keeps no slot of its own

found by the hop (reverse, via #843): The Obelus and the Tombstone (Johannes Sigil) defines the two marks of custody and philology as 'restoring correction authority to the dead', with the apparatus criticus as its machinery, and names Marx's Second Manuscript as a case of custody its author cannot contest: the archive's categories applied to the class of critical editions and to the custody of Marx's manuscripts (O-class)

After the Obelus: reads the 1932 Moscow MEGA edition as 'supply, marked' against Landshut–Mayer's silent supply (D); defines the critical apparatus as 'a genre of confession' and marked supply as the condition of what a tradition can think (O-class, the first class); its falsifier and its reading of the composition layer as unmarked supply bear on T's composition at the address

EA-CORPORA-02: MEGA philology (Meiser 1996) uncovered the Manifesto's false 1851 imprint, read as the archive's 'provenance inversion in the wild' (D, R: a relation of the edition to the archive's theory and its seat 02/02); the seating rule that excludes the MEGA apparatus as an edited-text hazard (D)

Measuring the Operation, Not the Name: the scoped test on Das Kapital II and III, which Engels edited from Marx's manuscripts, with its basis (volume I at 98% Marx): the archive's instrument applied to the editorial-intervention class (O-class, the second class)
The First Draft (2026-09-06): the earliest instance of the remaining test on Bde 2–3 (O-class); #1605, the notebook's later cut, states it again (S4: instance of this lineage)
Monetary Dark Matter: every collation run against MEGA² II/5–II/9 (D; R: the edition as the instrument of an archive work); its falsifier and stated limit name the II/6 apparatus

The Phases of Communism Are Not Phase X: its disambiguation keeps 'the 1844 manuscript tradition and its editors (MEGA; …)' as a sense of its own, apart from the archive's reconstruction (a limit the archive states on its own claims about the edition's volumes)

the census's anchor, Ils ne sont pas marxistes, read at the passages that name the entity's kind (BRIEF-NEW-ROW-LEFT §8): Marx's own texts treated as revisable and the critique of them as the synthesis; Engels's publication of the suppressed Gotha critique, a holder's act; the organ, holder and route; accumulated critical capacity in archives and libraries; The German Ideology manuscript 'left to the mice' (O-class, the second class). #1725 does not name the MEGA
